title: Secondary Rack With Porcelain Spool Insulator 1 Set For Electrical Distribution 1/2/3 Wire Set
description:

1.Secondary rack is an insulated cable support with a U shaped base for easy installation on the utility pole using bolt and nut.

3.The wires are suspended from a 'string' of identical disc-shaped insulators that attach to each other with metal clevis pin or ball and socket links.
